---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or capability for ContextAtlas
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Use case

Describe the situation where you would use this feature. What are
you trying to accomplish that ContextAtlas currently doesn't
support (or supports awkwardly)?

## Proposed solution

If you have a concrete proposal, describe it. Otherwise, describe
the desired outcome and we can discuss approach.

## Alternatives considered

What workarounds have you tried? What other approaches did you
consider?

## Scope

- Does this affect the MCP tool interface? (`get_symbol_context`,
  `find_by_intent`, `impact_of_change`)
- Does this affect the CLI? (`contextatlas index`, `doctor`,
  `generate-adrs`, etc.)
- Does this affect the atlas schema?
- Does this require a new ADR?
- Is this language-specific or language-agnostic?

## Additional context

Links to similar features in other tools, screenshots, related
issues, etc.
